tāpena grīṣme saṃśuṣkaṃ parasparagrathitaṃ ca darbhāgramiva jarājarjarā mūrdhajā
yasya

viruddhau varaśāpaphalatāvacchedakau śubhatvāśubhatvadharmāvekatraiva
dharmiṇyaśakyāṃ sthitiṃ kathaṃ gacchataḥ

ekadharmyāśritatvāsaṃbhave'pi
tayordharmayoḥ parasparāśritatvamastu tatrāha - ādhāra eveti

sarveṣāṃ praśnānāṃ kathāśeṣavarṇanamukhenaivottaraṃ kadambatāpasa uvāca -
saṃpaśyasīti
he sādho eteṣāṃ kiṃ viruddhamasamañjasaṃ paśyasi

adyatanavāsarādaṣṭame asminneva vāsare saṃprāpte sati bhavantau taṃ mathurāpradeśaṃ
svabāndhavasahitaṃ prāpsyata iti śeṣaḥ

tāni karmāṇi adhiṣṭhātārastattatphalapradā devāstadrūpāṇi bhūtvā peṭakaṃ
svasvānukūlasamūhaghaṭitaṃ saṃpuṭaṃ pṛthak pṛthak kariṣyanti

evaṃ
saṃpuṭībhūtā varāḥ śāpāśca pṛthak pṛthak śarīrā.i kariṣyanti

durvāsaso rudrāṃśatvena tadīyatvādduṣkarmaphaladānonmukhatvena ghorarūpatvācca
trinetrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ
tatra varā mūlādhikyātsvādhikyaṃ darśayanti - bhavanta iti

yato bhagavantaṃ
sūryaṃ munibhyaḥ purā dhātā asṛjaditi śeṣaḥ
supāṃ sulugiti cchāndaso'ḍādeśaḥ tā tā piṇḍānāmitivat

tatra saṃvido dṛḍhābhyāsena yadākāradārḍhyaṃ teṣāṃ prābalyamiti vaktuṃ
mūlasaṃvidaṃ darśayanti - vayaṃ kileti

tatra śāstrīyatapaḥkālikadṛḍhasaṃkalpavaśīkṛtādvaradātsaṃvidātmano
gṛhītatvādvarakalpanā cit kālāntare phalāvasthāyāṃ samyak bhṛtā puṣṭā yadā tadā
saivāntaḥsārā

yathā rajatabhramasya pramāṇadṛḍhīkṛte tvarthe
anapekṣitasya jñānasya jyeṣṭhatvaṃ bādhyatve tantramiti prasiddham

nyāyāntaraṃ na
kiṃcinmadaṃ śāpaprābalyaṃ kartumutsahate ityarthaḥ

ata eva yatra viruddhakarmaṇorvaraśāpayorvā pramāṇābhyāsādisāmyaṃ
tatrobhayamiśrameva phalaṃ bhavatītyāha - sameneti

yathaikakāle bhinnadeśabhogyau samau varaśāpau tatra
vipaścidupākhyānoktanyāyenopādhervibhāgenaikaiva jīvacidyugapaddehabhedena
dvirūpatāmāpadyata ityāha - samābhyāmiti

yathā svapneṣu purātmikā cit
puravāsijanadehabhedena vibhāgamivāpadyate tadvat

yattvatta eva śikṣitaṃ tattavaiva puraḥ punaḥ paṭhitaṃ dhārṣṭyāvahatvātpratīpaṃ
pratikūlamiti no dhārṣṭyāparādhaṃ kṣamasva

ataste namo'stu vayaṃ śīghraṃ
svasthānaṃ yāmaḥ

svayameva svaṃ vṛthā prayāsakāriṇaṃ svamaurkhyakhyāpakaṃ lajjayā śapatīti
svayaṃśāpastathāvidhaḥ san kvāpi yayau

yathā dṛṣṭestimiraroge praśānte sati
vyomni bhrāntikṛtaṃ keśoṇḍrakaṃ kvāpi yāti tadvat

evaṃ durvāsaḥśāpeṣu gateṣu atha anyaḥ saptadvīpādhipatyaviruddhasteṣāṃ
gṛhānnirgamasya rodhakaḥ anyastadbhāryābhyo datto gaurīvarapūgo
vaiyākaraṇaprakriyāyāmādeśaḥ sthānisthānamiva sūryavaraiḥ saha vivādārthaṃ
śāpasthānamabhyapūrayat

yataḥ so'pi samānaḥ arthastulyakālaṃ viruddhaṃ phalaṃ
yasya tathāvidhaḥ
śāpasthāne niviṣṭāḥ śāpasthānakāḥ patnīvarā brahmāṇaṃ prati vadiṣyanti

he deveśa bhāvisaptadvīpeśatvenābhimatānāmeteṣāṃ
jīvānāṃ śavasadmano bahirniryāṇaṃ vayaṃ na vidmaḥ

yāvat yato
bhavatāṃ ciraṃ neṣṭau parasparecchāvirahepi te'ṣṭau bhrātaro maraṇottarakṣaṇādeva
cirāya svasadana eva saptadvīpeśvarā bhūtvā sthitāḥ

yato yuṣmābhirasmābhiśca
vyaṣṭisamaṣṭibhiryuktaṃ sarvaṃ jagadvyomātmakaṃ saccitparamāṇvantaḥ
sthitamantaḥsvapna evānubhūyate atastat paramāṇorapyantasthe svagṛhodare bhātīti
pareṇānvayaḥ
yadidaṃ jagattvaṃ bhāti tat tvaṃ cideva

yataścinmātrameva tadbhāti ato na
kvacijjaganmūrtamasti yadgṛhe na bhāyādityarthaḥ

tānprākkalpitānādhibhautikabhrāntimayān dehakāṃstattvavicāreṇa saṃtyajya
ātivāhikadehinaḥ santaḥ ajaṃ praṇamya avirodhātsamaṃ sākaṃ tattanmanaḥkalpite
saptadvīpe tattaddevānāṃ gṛhakośān jagmuriti pareṇānvayaḥ

te'ṣṭau bhrātarastatra gṛhe
iṣṭairyajñādikasatkarmabhirbandhujanaiśca āpuṣṭānāṃ jagadaṣṭakabhedena
brahmadināṣṭake ādimahībhujāṃ svāyaṃbhuvamanūnāṃ kule iti śeṣaḥ

uddhṛtairutpāṭitairdigdantidantairākṛṣṭāḥ kulācalā varṣaparvatā yena tathāvidhaḥ
san

tyaktaḥ ābhimānikākāra ātivāhikadehākāre'pi yaistathāvidhāḥ santasteṣāmaṣṭānāṃ
jīvasaṃvidbhirekatāṃ yāsyantīti pareṇānvayaḥ

iti uktaprakāraṃ saptadvīpādhipatyaṃ tapobhiḥ
pravikasitaḥ pūrvoditavaraḥ kriyārtho yeṣāṃ tathāvidhā ete'ṣṭau bhrātaraḥ prāpsyanti

vidaḥ pratyakcaitanyasya antardṛḍhaniścayātmanā yatsphurati tadeva bāhye
taducitatapojapādikarmabhiḥ kairnāptam
